Definition: something lighted, i.e. an aperture; by implication, a crevice or hole (of a serpent)
BiblicalUsage: The word is a hole or aperture, and Isaiah uses it once, in the picture of the age of peace: the sucking child shall play on the hole of the asp, and nothing shall hurt or destroy in all God's holy mountain.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the child at the serpent's hole is the promise that peace will reach the most dangerous places: where death used to live, a child will play, and nothing will hurt.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
